turns.user_utterance: There is a problem with my card. Somebody has removed money from my account in a town I haven't been to. Can you please freeze my account immediately?
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry this has happened. I can help you secure your card/account—are you asking to freeze/block your card due to suspected unauthorized activity (card being used without your knowledge), or do you want to report the specific card payment as unrecognized so we can investigate it?

turns.user_utterance: I want to freeze the card – it’s been used without my permission.
turns.assistant_response: Understood—I'll help you freeze/block your card due to suspected unauthorized use. Please confirm: is your card currently with you, or has it been lost/stolen as well? If it’s with you, we’ll proceed as a compromised card; if not, we’ll treat it as lost/stolen.
